item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-01
item.description:
It's been an exciting period across our open-source research tools, with notable updates in several projects. In the `scienceverse/metacheck` project, Lakens added stat output to the `data_check` branch, enhancing the tool's capabilities. Meanwhile, `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing` saw updates to its `gh-pages` and `master` branches, focusing on documentation and user interface adjustments, including a site build for version `tenzing@0.4.1`. The `lhdjung/scrutiny` project also made progress, with updates to its `main` and `gh-pages` branches, including deployments marked by successful releases 🚀. Additionally, the `quest-bih/oddpub` project improved its ontogenerator, adding detection capabilities for nature das and cas, demonstrating the community's ongoing efforts to advance research tools. These updates highlight the connections and collaborations between projects, celebrating the progress and innovation within our community.

22 commits across 4 active repositories this week.

item.title: scrutiny: activity update
item.description:
lhdjung/scrutiny

The `main` branch saw changes to the CITATION.cff file, with Lukas Jung updating it, and later adding a `date-released` field. The `gh-pages` branch was updated twice, with deployments from the `lhdjung/scrutiny` repository at specific commits, as indicated by the messages "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009" and "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238". Both deployments were marked with a rocket ship emoji, 🚀, indicating a successful deployment. Work was done on both the `main` and `gh-pages` branches.

⚠ This repository was dormant and has recently become active again.
